import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MAXN = 25;
    static final int INF = 10007;
    static final int MAXT = 65;
    static final int MAXC = 12;

    static int n, k;
    static String[] Sgrid, Tgrid;
    static int[][] distZ;
    static int[][][][][] dp;
    static int[] dx = {1, 0, -1, 0};
    static int[] dy = {0, 1, 0, -1};
    static ArrayList<int[]> starts = new ArrayList<>();
    static ArrayList<int[]> ends = new ArrayList<>();

    static class Dinic {
        static class Edge {
            int to, rev, cap;
            Edge(int t, int r, int c) {
                to = t;
                rev = r;
                cap = c;
            }
        }

        int n;
        ArrayList<ArrayList<Edge>> g;
        int[] level, ptr;

        Dinic(int n) {
            this.n = n;
            g = new ArrayList<>(n);
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) g.add(new ArrayList<>());
            level = new int[n];
            ptr = new int[n];
        }

        void addEdge(int v, int to, int cap) {
            Edge a = new Edge(to, g.get(to).size(), cap);
            Edge b = new Edge(v, g.get(v).size(), 0);
            g.get(v).add(a);
            g.get(to).add(b);
        }

        boolean bfs(int s, int t) {
            Arrays.fill(level, -1);
            ArrayDeque<Integer> q = new ArrayDeque<>();
            level[s] = 0;
            q.add(s);
            while (!q.isEmpty()) {
                int v = q.poll();
                for (Edge e : g.get(v)) {
                    if (e.cap > 0 && level[e.to] == -1) {
                        level[e.to] = level[v] + 1;
                        q.add(e.to);
                    }
                }
            }
            return level[t] != -1;
        }

        int dfs(int v, int t, int pushed) {
            if (pushed == 0) return 0;
            if (v == t) return pushed;
            for (; ptr[v] < g.get(v).size(); ptr[v]++) {
                Edge e = g.get(v).get(ptr[v]);
                if (level[e.to] != level[v] + 1 || e.cap <= 0) continue;
                int tr = dfs(e.to, t, Math.min(pushed, e.cap));
                if (tr == 0) continue;
                e.cap -= tr;
                g.get(e.to).get(e.rev).cap += tr;
                return tr;
            }
            return 0;
        }

        int maxFlow(int s, int t) {
            int flow = 0;
            while (bfs(s, t)) {
                Arrays.fill(ptr, 0);
                while (true) {
                    int pushed = dfs(s, t, Integer.MAX_VALUE);
                    if (pushed == 0) break;
                    flow += pushed;
                }
            }
            return flow;
        }
    }

    static void bfsFromZ(int sx, int sy) {
        distZ = new int[MAXN][MAXN];
        for (int i = 0; i < MAXN; i++) Arrays.fill(distZ[i], -1);
        ArrayDeque<int[]> q = new ArrayDeque<>();
        distZ[sx][sy] = 0;
        q.add(new int[]{sx, sy});
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int[] p = q.poll();
            int x = p[0], y = p[1];
            for (int d = 0; d < 4; d++) {
                int nx = x + dx[d];
                int ny = y + dy[d];
                if (nx < 0 || nx >= n || ny < 0 || ny >= n) continue;
                if (distZ[nx][ny] != -1) continue;
                if (Tgrid[nx].charAt(ny) == 'Y' || Tgrid[nx].charAt(ny) == 'Z') continue;
                distZ[nx][ny] = distZ[x][y] + 1;
                q.add(new int[]{nx, ny});
            }
        }
    }

    static int ok(int t, int x0, int y0, int x, int y) {
        if (distZ[x0][y0] < t) return 0;
        if (x0 == x && y0 == y) return 1;
        if (t >= k) return 0;
        if (distZ[x0][y0] <= t) return 0;
        if (dp[t][x0][y0][x][y] != -1) return dp[t][x0][y0][x][y];
        for (int d = 0; d < 4; d++) {
            int nx = x0 + dx[d];
            int ny = y0 + dy[d];
            if (nx < 0 || nx >= n || ny < 0 || ny >= n) continue;
            if (Sgrid[nx].charAt(ny) == 'Y' || Sgrid[nx].charAt(ny) == 'Z') continue;
            if (ok(t + 1, nx, ny, x, y) == 1) return dp[t][x0][y0][x][y] = 1;
        }
        return dp[t][x0][y0][x][y] = 0;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        PrintWriter out = new PrintWriter(System.out);

        String[] parts = br.readLine().split(" ");
        n = Integer.parseInt(parts[0]);
        k = Integer.parseInt(parts[1]);

        Sgrid = new String[n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) Sgrid[i] = br.readLine();
        Tgrid = new String[n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) Tgrid[i] = br.readLine();

        int zx = -1, zy = -1;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (Tgrid[i].charAt(j) == 'Z') {
                    zx = i;
                    zy = j;
                }
            }
        }

        bfsFromZ(zx, zy);

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (distZ[i][j] == -1) distZ[i][j] = INF;
            }
        }

        starts.clear();
        ends.clear();
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                char c = Sgrid[i].charAt(j);
                if (c != 'Z' && c != 'Y' && c != '0') starts.add(new int[]{i, j});
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                char c = Tgrid[i].charAt(j);
                if (c != 'Z' && c != 'Y' && c != '0') ends.add(new int[]{i, j});
            }
        }

        int S = 0;
        int T = starts.size() + ends.size() + 1;
        Dinic dinic = new Dinic(T + 1);

        for (int i = 0; i < starts.size(); i++) {
            int[] p = starts.get(i);
            dinic.addEdge(S, i + 1, Sgrid[p[0]].charAt(p[1]) - '0');
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < ends.size(); i++) {
            int[] p = ends.get(i);
            dinic.addEdge(starts.size() + i + 1, T, Tgrid[p[0]].charAt(p[1]) - '0');
        }

        dp = new int[MAXT][MAXC][MAXC][MAXC][MAXC];
        for (int a = 0; a < MAXT; a++)
            for (int b = 0; b < MAXC; b++)
                for (int c = 0; c < MAXC; c++)
                    for (int d = 0; d < MAXC; d++)
                        for (int e = 0; e < MAXC; e++)
                            dp[a][b][c][d][e] = -1;

        for (int i = 0; i < starts.size(); i++) {
            int[] s = starts.get(i);
            for (int j = 0; j < ends.size(); j++) {
                int[] e = ends.get(j);
                if (ok(0, s[0], s[1], e[0], e[1]) == 1) {
                    dinic.addEdge(i + 1, starts.size() + j + 1, INF);
                }
            }
        }

        out.println(dinic.maxFlow(S, T));
        out.flush();
        out.close();
        br.close();
    }
}
